deduction.rule.type.allAbsent.text.china: When neither Florist nor Theater spawns, Butcher, Aromatic Indulgence and Restaurant all spawn.
deduction.rule.type.atLeast1.text: At least one of the two spawns a cipher.
deduction.rule.type.atMost1.text: At most one of the two spawns a cipher.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.chinaTown: Tailor's Shop Inside - Florist - Butcher - Aromatic Indulgence: no three consecutive positions may all have ciphers.
Grocery Store - Red Umbrella Alley - Restaurant - Aromatic Indulgence - Theater - Lion Pagoda - Grocery Store: no three consecutive positions may all have ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.darkwoods: Campsite - Treehouse Checkpoint -  Hunter's Cottage Inside - Hunter's Cottage Outside - Bonfire - Ruins (Side Entrance) - Upper Riverside Single Pallet - Upper Riverside Double Pallets - Riverside 2F - Lower Riverside: two adjacent positions cannot both have ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.lakesideV: Cornfield - Cottage - Boat - Ruins (Boat) - Construction Site Shed: two adjacent positions cannot both have ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.leosMemor: Side Entrance - Oil Drums - Center Field - Containers: two adjacent positions cannot both have ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.moonlitRi: Circus - Lion Cage - Platform 4 - Merry-go-round - Platform 3: two pentagon-adjacent positions cannot both lack ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.sacredHea: Cottage - Decrepit Cottage E - Decrepit Cottage W - Hospital Statue - Ruins (West) - Main Entrance Wall - Main Entrance Triple Pallets - Abandoned Statue - Ruins (East): two circle-adjacent positions cannot both lack ciphers
deduction.rule.type.chain.text.theRedChu: Ruins (Dilapidated Wall) S - Ruins (Dilapidated Wall) N - Dead Zone Cipher - Ruins (Side Entrance): two adjacent positions cannot both have ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.exactly.text: Exactly {value} of the {count} positions spawn ciphers.
deduction.rule.type.implies.text.leosMem: Side Entrance area (Side Entrance / Oil Drums) and Cottage always match: both spawn or both absent.
deduction.rule.type.link.east.text: Three ciphers in the east means Christmas Tree spawns; two means it doesn't (mutually indicative).
deduction.rule.type.link.west.text: Three ciphers in the west means Ruins (Water Tank) doesn't spawn; two means it does (mutually indicative).
deduction.rule.type.same.text: Both positions always match: both spawn or both absent.
